battle.name: 韓戰
battle.brief: 1950年6月，韓戰在朝鮮半島爆發，聯合國軍與北韓及中國人民志願軍在三八線南北反覆爭奪。美軍投入已列裝的M26潘興坦克，以90毫米主砲支援步兵突破陣地並對抗對方T-34。

kit.name: M26潘興坦克
kit.history: 1944年列裝的美軍重型坦克，韓戰期間配屬地面部隊，用於近距火力支援與對抗對方中型坦克。

countries: 參戰的主要國家與勢力包括：以美國為首的聯合國軍（共 16 國），其中美國提供最大兵力與空中、海上支援；英國、澳洲、加拿大、土耳其、泰國、菲律賓等國亦派遣步兵或後勤單位。中華人民共和國於 1950 年 10 月派遣「中國人民志願軍」介入，兵力高峰達 30 萬人。北韓的人民軍得到蘇聯的武器裝備與顧問支持；南韓政府軍（ROK）在美軍指導下擴編，並裝備美式武器與輕裝甲車。雙方在政治與意識形態上分屬資本主義與共產主義陣營，形成全方位的冷戰對抗格局。
countriesEn: The main belligerents comprised the United Nations forces led by the United States (16 nations in total). The U.S. contributed the bulk of troops and provided air and naval support, while Britain, Australia, Canada, Turkey, Thailand, the Philippines and others sent infantry or logistical units. The People’s Republic of China entered the conflict in October 1950 by dispatching the Chinese People’s Volunteer Army, whose strength peaked at roughly 300,000 men. North Korea’s People’s Army received Soviet weapons, equipment and advisors; the Republic of Korea (ROK) forces, under U.S. guidance, expanded and were equipped with American arms and light armor. Politically and ideologically the two sides belonged to the capitalist and communist blocs, creating a full‑scale Cold‑War confrontation in the region.
people: 這場戰爭的關鍵人物與編制多樣。美國方面，遠東軍總司令道格拉斯·麥克阿瑟（Douglas MacArthur）主導仁川登陸及整體戰略；第八集團軍司令沃爾頓·沃克（Walton Walker）負責前線防守；第 1 騎兵師師長赫伯恩·霍爾（Hubert H. Harmon）以及第 24 步兵師師長威廉·F·迪恩（William F. Dean）皆在初期抵擋北韓進攻。中華志願軍由彭德懷元帥統率，副司令兼政治委員為陳賡，指揮第 13 兵團、第 9 兵團等部隊在雲山、德川一帶展開激烈戰鬥。北韓方面，金日成直接掌握最高指揮權，副首相兼人民軍總參謀長等策劃進攻。整體兵力在 1950 年底達到高峰，聯合國軍約有 25 萬人，志願軍約 30 萬人，北韓與南韓兵力亦相當龐大。
peopleEn: The war’s key figures and unit organizations were varied. On the U.S. side, General Douglas MacArthur, commander of the Far East Command, directed the Inchon landings and overall strategy; General Walton Walker commanded the Eighth Army on the front line; the 1st Cavalry Division’s commander, Major General Hubert H. Harmon, and the 24th Infantry Division’s commander, Major General William F. Dean, fought early battles against the North Korean advance. The Chinese Volunteer Army was led by Marshal Peng Dehuai, with Deputy Commander and Political Commissioner Chen Geng directing the 13th and 9th Corps in the battles around Wonsan and Kunri. In North Korea, Kim Il‑sung held supreme command, while the Deputy Prime Minister and Chief of the General Staff coordinated offensives. By the end of 1950, UN forces numbered about 250,000, the Volunteers around 300,000, and both North and South Korean armies were also substantial.
kits: 雙方投入的武器裝備多為 1950 年前已列裝的真實型號。聯合國軍主要使用美式步槍 M1 加蘭德、半自動步槍 M2 卡賓槍、手槍 M1911；機槍包括 M1919 布朗寧等。裝甲方面，M4 謝爾曼、M26 潘興與 M46 巴頓坦克在戰場上充當先鋒；輕裝甲車如 M3/M5 斯圖亞特則負責偵察與快速支援。炮兵配備 M101 105mm 榴彈炮、M114 155mm 榴彈炮與 M2A1 203mm 榴彈炮，提供遠程火力壓制。北韓軍隊主要裝備蘇制 T‑34/85 與 SU‑76 自行火炮，步槍為莫辛‑納甘和 SKS，機槍則有 DP‑27 與 PPSh‑41。中華志願軍則使用蘇聯援助的 PPSh‑41、DP‑27、RPG‑2 火箭筒，以及自製的五六式步槍；炮兵裝備包括 122mm M‑30 與 152mm ML‑20 榴彈炮。空中方面，美軍投入 F‑80 流星、F‑84 雷電等噴射機提供近距離空中支援與攔截。
kitsEn: The weapons and equipment employed were real models that had entered service before or during 1950. UN forces relied chiefly on the U.S.‑made M1 Garand rifle, the M2 carbine, and the M1911 pistol; machine guns included the M1919 Browning. Their armor comprised M4 Sherman, M26 Pershing and M46 Patton tanks, while light armored vehicles such as the M3/M5 Stuart performed reconnaissance and rapid support roles. Artillery included the M101 105 mm howitzer, the M114 155 mm howitzer and the M2A1 203 mm howitzer for long‑range fire. North Korean units were equipped mainly with Soviet T‑34/85 tanks and SU‑76 self‑propelled guns, Mosin‑Nagant and SKS rifles, and DP‑27 and PPSh‑41 machine guns. The Chinese Volunteers used Soviet‑supplied PPSh‑41 submachine guns, DP‑27 machine guns, RPG‑2 rocket launchers, and domestically produced Type 56 rifles; their artillery consisted of 122 mm M‑30 and 152 mm ML‑20 howitzers. In the air, the U.S. deployed F‑80 Shooting Star and F‑84 Thunderjet jets for close‑air support and interceptors.
tactics: 戰術層面上，雙方均展現多樣化與適應性。北韓在戰爭初期採用快速滲透與「人海」突擊戰術，以裝甲師（T‑34/85）與步兵師混合編隊，在公路沿線以機動方式突破南韓防線，迫使聯合國軍在烏山、大田一帶節節敗退。針對此威脅，麥克阿瑟策劃「仁川登陸」戰役，運用兩棲作戰、迂迴包抄與集中火力，於 1950 年 9 月 15 日成功登陸並切斷北韓補給線，迫使敵軍回防首爾。此後，聯合國軍在「釜山防禦圈」中以嚴密的步兵防線、密集的炮兵與空軍轟炸構築防線，並使用「M」形防禦與縱深部署消耗北韓攻勢。中華志願軍則在雲山、德川一帶展開「運動戰」，以小股游擊、伏擊與夜襲相結合，並利用山岳地形掩護，集中兵力對敵側翼進行包圍。各方皆重視後勤保障與彈藥運輸，特別是在漫長的冬季補給線上維持燃料、彈藥與食物的持續供應。
tacticsEn: On the tactical level both sides displayed adaptability. Early in the war North Korea used rapid infiltration and “human‑wave” assaults, combining tank units (T‑34/85) with infantry divisions to break through South Korean lines along main roads, pushing UN forces back at Osan and Taejon. In response, MacArthur planned the Inchon amphibious operation, employing a flanking maneuver and concentrated fire that secured the landing on 15 September 1950, cut the North Korean supply lines and forced enemy troops to retreat toward Seoul. Afterwards, UN forces entrenched in the Pusan Perimeter built dense infantry positions, heavy artillery concentrations and continuous air bombardments, using “M‑shaped” defenses and deep‑layered deployments to wear down the North Korean assaults. The Chinese Volunteers fought a “mobile war” around Wonsan and Kunri, employing small‑unit guerrilla tactics, ambushes and night raids, leveraging mountainous terrain to concentrate forces for flanking encirclements. Both sides emphasized logistics, ensuring a steady flow of fuel, ammunition and supplies over the long, harsh winter lines.
data: 具體的時間與兵力流向可歸納如下：1950 年 6 月 25 日 03:30，北韓第 1、第 3、第 4 師共約 10 萬人跨過 38 度線，突襲甕津、議政府等城市。7 月 5 日，美第 1 騎兵師在鳥山（Osan）與北韓第 4 師交火，標誌美軍首次正式介入。7 月 20 日，美第 24 師師長威廉·F·迪恩在大田（Taejon）被俘，師部被迫撤至釜山。8 月 5 日至 9 月 15 日，釜山防禦圈內雙方展開激烈消耗戰，聯軍每日平均消耗彈藥約 2,000 噸，飛機出動次數高達 1,200 架次。9 月 15 日，麥克阿瑟率第 10 兵團在仁川登陸，兵力約 70,000 人，配備 2 艘戰艦、12 艘登陸艇。10 月 19 日，志願軍第 13 兵團在雲山發動第一次大規模進攻，投入兵力約 6 萬人，配屬 122mm 榴彈炮 300 門。10 月 25 日至 12 月 24 日，志願軍在長津湖（Chosin Reservoir）與美第 1 海軍陸戰師激烈交火，雙方傷亡慘重。12 月 15 日，聯軍被迫撤離平壤，於 1951 年 1 月 4 日重新占領首爾。此後雙方在 38 度線形成靜態對峙，直至 1953 年 7 月 27 日簽署停戰協定。
dataEn: The detailed chronology and force movements can be summarized as follows: at 03:30 on 25 June 1950, the North Korean I, III and IV Divisions, roughly 100,000 men, crossed the 38th parallel, striking the cities of Ongjin and Üiju. On 5 July, the U.S. 1st Cavalry Division engaged the North Korean 4th Division at Osan, marking the first U.S. ground action. On 20 July, Major General William F. Dean of the 24th Infantry Division was captured at Taejon, and his division retreated toward Pusan. From 5 August to 15 September, the Pusan Perimeter saw fierce attritional fighting, with UN forces expending about 2,000 tons of ammunition daily and launching up to 1,200 aircraft sorties per day. On 15 September, MacArthur’s X Corps landed at Inchon with about 70,000 troops, supported by two warships and twelve landing ships. On 19 October, the Chinese 13th Corps launched its first major offensive at Wonsan, committing roughly 60,000 troops and 300 122 mm howitzers. From 25 October to 24 December, the Volunteers clashed with the U.S. 1st Marine Division at the Chosin Reservoir, causing heavy casualties on both sides. On 15 December, UN forces evacuated Pyongyang, and on 4 January 1951 they recaptured Seoul. From then on, both sides dug in along the 38th parallel until the armistice was signed on 27 July 1953.
cause: 1945 年二戰結束，韓半島被美蘇分割，北緯 38 度線為臨時分界。蘇聯扶持金日成建立北韓政權，美國支持李承晚的南韓政府。1948‑49 年兩韓各自成立政府，雙方軍備競賽升溫。金日成在蘇聯和中共的秘密支援下，於 1950 年 6 月 25 日凌晨突擊越過 38 度線，全面侵略南韓，意圖以武力統一全島。這一決定源於冷戰意識形態對抗、邊界爭端及金日成對蘇聯裝備與援助的信心，成為戰爭的直接導火線。
causeEn: In 1945, the end of World War II led to the division of the Korean Peninsula between the United States and the Soviet Union, with the 38th parallel serving as a temporary demarcation line. The USSR installed Kim Il‑sung to head the North Korean regime, while the United States backed Syngman Rhee’s South Korean government. In 1948‑49 each side established its own state, sparking an arms race. Backed secretly by Moscow and Beijing, Kim Il‑sung launched a surprise offensive across the 38th parallel in the early hours of 25 June 1950, aiming to reunify the peninsula by force. This decision, rooted in Cold‑War ideology, border disputes, and confidence in Soviet arms and support, became the immediate cause of the war.
impact: 韓戰對全球政治格局與地區安全產生深遠影響。首先，它將美國的亞洲防線推向日本海與台灣海峽，形成「遏制」共產主義的東亞防線，並促使美國在韓國永久部署軍隊。其次，戰爭讓新中國首次以「志願軍」形式參與國際軍事行動，提升了中共的國際地位，但也付出慘重代價，死亡與失蹤人數估計在 30 萬至 40 萬人之間。北韓的經濟與人口損失亦極為慘重，基礎設施被毀，農業停滯。此役亦促成了日本在 1951 年《舊金山和約》後快速經濟復甦，並使日本成為美軍在遠東的重要後勤基地。軍事上，雙方在火力、空中支援與機械化作戰方面累積了寶貴經驗，直接影響了後續的越南戰爭戰術與裝備發展。冷戰的「兩極」格局在韓戰後更加固化，形成以美國與蘇聯為首的兩大陣營在亞洲的長期對抗。
impactEn: The Korean War profoundly reshaped global politics and regional security. First, it pushed the United States’ Asian defense line to the seas east of Korea and the Taiwan Strait, establishing a “containment” front against communism in East Asia and leading to a permanent U.S. military presence in South Korea. Second, the war marked the first time the new People’s Republic of China entered an international conflict as a “volunteer” force, elevating its stature but at a heavy cost – estimates of dead and missing range from 300,000 to 400,000. North Korea suffered enormous economic and demographic losses, with infrastructure devastated and agriculture stalled. The conflict also spurred Japan’s rapid post‑war economic recovery, turning it into a crucial logistic base for U.S. forces in the Far East. Militarily, both sides gained valuable experience in firepower, air support and mechanized warfare, lessons that directly shaped tactics and equipment in the later Vietnam War. The Cold War’s bipolar structure hardened after Korea, solidifying a long‑term U.S.–Soviet rivalry across Asia.
result: 最終結果為 1953 年 7 月 27 日在板門店簽署《停戰協定》，結束了實際上的武裝衝突。停戰線基本上沿 38 度線設立，並設立非軍事區（DMZ）分隔雙方。雖然戰爭正式終止，但雙方未簽署和平條約，技術上仍處於戰爭狀態。根據美方統計，聯合國軍在此役中陣亡約 36,574 人、受傷約 103,284 人；中國人民志願軍傷亡約 197,000 人；北韓與南韓的傷亡總數則估計在 200 萬至 300 萬人之間。停戰後，南韓在美國軍事援助下快速現代化，經濟起飛；北韓則在蘇聯與中共支援下建立高度集中的計劃經濟，並持續發展核武與導彈計劃。整體而言，韓戰確立了韓半島的分治現狀，並在冷戰史中留下深刻印記。
resultEn: The final outcome was the signing of the Armistice Agreement at Panmunjom on 27 July 1953, ending active hostilities. The ceasefire line was drawn roughly along the 38th parallel, and a Demilitarized Zone (DMZ) was created to separate the two sides. Although the war formally ceased, no peace treaty was concluded, leaving the Koreas technically still at war. According to U.S. figures, UN forces suffered about 36,574 killed and 103,284 wounded; Chinese People’s Volunteer Army casualties were roughly 197,000; combined North and South Korean losses are estimated between two and three million. After the armistice, South Korea, with U.S. military aid, modernized rapidly and experienced an economic boom, while North Korea, backed by the USSR and China, built a centrally planned economy and continued developing nuclear weapons and missiles. In sum, the Korean War cemented the division of the peninsula and left a lasting imprint on Cold‑War history.
